The '''Model 7 Therm-ax''' was a weapon manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 850 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It looked like a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] but its head reached temperatures in excess of 500 degrees.<ref name="DC" />
